name: The Wicked
overview: Scripture reveals that the wicked oppose the righteous and seek their harm, yet their ultimate fate is assuredly judgment and destruction. The Lord promises that the wicked will be trodden down and reduced to ashes, emphasizing the certainty of divine justice. Believers are urged to fear God rather than those who can only harm the body, for God alone has authority over both soul and body in eternal punishment. While the wicked face everlasting fire and punishment, the righteous are granted eternal life and reign with Christ, secure from the power of the second death.
